description: Production Quotidienne Définitive et Régionalisée de Biométhane sur le réseau de distribution et de transport is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données donne l'évolution de la production régionale de biométhane en France aux sites d'injection dans le réseau de transport et de distribution. Les données sont définitives. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Production, Territoires et régions. Its keywords are EnR, Biogaz. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
